class: Primary published ISA/debugger documentation, not a native detector receipt; remote PDF not hashed

intel.excerpt: The processor generates the exception after it executes the instruction that made the access
intel.interpretation: Data watch conditions produce trap-class events after access; execute conditions fault before. Source-access PC and raw context PC must be separated. No generic RIP-minus-fixed-length for unknown branches/string access.

microsoft.interpretation: r means read or write, w means write, e means instruction execution. x64 sizes1/2/4/8 describe watched memory windows, not the width of the triggering instruction.
